body:
## Summary
- Greet a new conversation with three welcome messages.
- Add a Medas mark (a heartbeat line drawn as the letter M on a teal tile) for the chat header and the browser tab. The header uses the `MedasMark` component; `app/icon.svg` is a heavier-stroke variant for 16px and replaces `favicon.ico`.

## Test plan
- [x] `yarn lint`, `yarn format:check`, `yarn tsc --noEmit`, `yarn test` (69 passing)
- [x] Page links `/icon.svg` as its only icon
- [ ] Check the header mark once signed in

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
